notes: Recognize comments, delimiters and terminators only outside quoted strings.
Trim surrounding whitespace on numeric values. Preserve string content and raw lines; trim identifier padding only for comparison keys.
Exactly two physical title lines follow case identification, including blank lines. Ignore @! headers elsewhere.

Sections occur in section_order[REV]. Each standalone zero terminator advances to the next section, including empty sections. Slash comments and @! headers are optional and are never required to identify sections or fields.
Integer fields are base-10; number fields allow decimal and scientific notation. No defaults or value bounds are inferred from examples.

section_identification.initial_section: first entry in section_order[REV] after case identification and two title lines
section_identification.empty_sections: retain a terminator for each empty section
section_identification.comment_labels: optional annotations; do not select sections or record layouts
section_identification.field_headers: optional annotations; field positions come from layouts[REV]
